scope: Independent semantic assessment of preliminary DRAFT rev8 and documentary preservation; no physical/engineering calculations

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Four machine functions plus RF manufacture are identifiable; F05 integration must observe both good and unejected outputs.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Function subcriteria, comparable conditions and completeness of the future program.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: BP500 design feedstock intent is separate from real lot qualification and historical construction wood.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Wet/dry basis, methods, actual composition/fraction/density/contamination limits.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Product forming, post-hold state and complete ejection are distinct; dose mass cannot establish product quality.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Product tolerances, hold conditions/time, defects and allowable residual criterion.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Conditional up-to output is a comparison reference; no guaranteed minimum or mass-rate multiplication is justified.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Comparable window, material/settings, good output, rejects/downtime/energy criteria.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Transitions distinguish command, permission and observation; feed presence does not prove a full dose.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: State coverage, valid signals, thresholds/timeouts, actual cycle and parallelism.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Feed/press interfaces and responsibility are required; source hopper capacity is not a completed dose.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Preparation/cleaning boundary, real flow, buffering and interface specification.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Site adapts to the eventual press; electrical source candidates are not own demand or ready site.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Own operating/start duty, protection and tolerances; reconcile source power before numeric use.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Own hydraulic architecture and phase contacts are needed; oil and material pressure/forces are distinct.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Actual phase forces/contacts/areas/losses/ranges and literal pressure interpretation.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Strength, stiffness, stability and life require case-specific loads, joints, supports and criteria.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Real geometry, material grades, boundaries/joints, loads, tolerances and life criteria.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Hazard identification is required before protective-function adequacy can be judged.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Hazard modes/zones, safety-function scope/performance and competent applicability review.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Failure recovery and safe unloading need own residual-energy evidence; donor dwell proves nothing about zero reaction.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Safe-state definition, residual forces/energy, timings, setpoints and authorized program.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Measurement validity is explicit; missing/invalid signals cannot confirm no motion or full dose.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Channels, sensitivity, valid F window, calibration/synchronization and thresholds; OBS04 OPEN.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Indoor environment and raw-material moisture are distinct; other moisture windows do not replace BP500.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Own exposures/environment, wet/dry measurement method, uncertainty and tolerances.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Real dust/contaminants/coatings/glue require qualification and risk measures; ARS nonmetal context is no safety evidence.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Actual hazard properties/composition, methods, allowable limits and mitigation evidence.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Access, isolation, residual energy and completion are specified as future service duties, not demonstrated maintainability.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Actual accesses, operations/isolation, compatibility and service intervals.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Own envelope, mass/CoG and reactions must be established; source ordering does not assign axes or moving mass.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Own dimensions/axes/masses, foundation/reactions, transport/service clearances.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: RF manufacture is a project feasibility requirement; brochure components/brands do not lock BOM or layout.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Vendor capabilities, materials/routes, component execution, interfaces and tolerances.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Normative applicability is a project duty regarding machine/interfaces, separate from product commercialization.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Machine classification/jurisdiction and applicable normative documents/revisions; no invented levels.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Reproducible package/provenance is an auditable project duty; integrity CI is not engineering acceptance.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Future delivery composition, acceptance criteria and applicable engineering evidence.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Program review precedes separate execution authorization; G1 itself is not evidence of future results.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Methods/revisions/metrology/uncertainty, sample sizes and thresholds in independently reviewed program.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: New requirements provenance distinguishes old source review from this output review and preserves user direction.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Physical applicability of donor declarations remains unconfirmed; decision/provenance chain must stay explicit.

semantic_requirements.documentary_assessment: Many-to-many lineage retains splits/refills/changeover, failed cycles, residuals/losses and unknown fractions.
semantic_requirements.mandatory_inputs_before_acceptance: Actual full-series records, measured fractions/masses, completeness criteria and executable log schema.

Indoor integrated-source arrangement informs an adaptable site, not a measured ready installation.
Fluid/monitoring/thermal functions are relevant; actual material/seal/component compatibility is unproven.
PLC/HMI functions are examples; named brands do not select own PLC or prove READY.

Pressure/position branches inform comparison only; ARS also covers nonmetals, yet its forces/friction/density are not REV.
Donor dwell/open/eject ordering does not prove residual unload or safe opening of REV.
